description: ecoinvent books carbon released when land changes use as `Carbon dioxide, from soil or biomass stock`, `Carbon monoxide, from soil or biomass stock` and `Methane, from soil or biomass stock`. Its correspondence table sends every one to EF 3.1's land-use-change flow of the same gas, where EF states +1 kg CO2-eq for carbon dioxide. openLCA LCIA Methods 2.8.2 ships seventeen of these rows under ecoinvent's own uuids and names -- five carbon dioxide, six carbon monoxide and six methane -- and nothing read the phrase on them. On the six-list build of 23 October 2026 (commit 5802a4c) the twelve with a registry number reached the plain gas by number and name, creating four carbon dioxide emission flows of unstated origin in air that nothing else feeds and no method characterises, and the five without one created `..., From Soil Or Biomass Stock` flows of their own. GreenDelta's factors for the same uuids meanwhile sat on the land-use-change flows, reached through ecoinvent's mapping, so an inventory mapped through openLCA's rows scored the release at zero where the same flow through ecoinvent's scored +1. `Carbon dioxide, in air`, the uptake row beside them (cc6a1abb), reached a plain carbon dioxide resource the merge created, where ecoinvent's row, BAFU's three and AGRIBALYSE's two reach EF's biogenic uptake. See #435 for the rows under ecoinvent uuids generally.

subject.name: Carbon Dioxide, From Soil Or Biomass Stock

expectations.comment: One indoor flow on the build of 5802a4c, created by openLCA's 5188df39. The carbon monoxide and methane spellings are the same question and are covered by the row claims above.

expectations.title: No carbon dioxide emission of unstated origin is published in unspecified air
expectations.comment: EF 3.1 ships carbon dioxide of unstated origin in water and soil only. On the build of 5802a4c four such flows existed in air, one per compartment, each created by one openLCA from-soil row and carrying no factor. This one stands for the four.

expectations.title: openLCA's `Carbon dioxide, in air` resource reaches EF's biogenic uptake from air
expectations.comment: Where ecoinvent's row of the same uuid goes by its table, BAFU's three by override (#135) and AGRIBALYSE's two by rule. On the build of 5802a4c it reached the number on `cas+label` and created a plain `Carbon Dioxide` resource in air.

expectations.title: No carbon dioxide resource of unstated origin is published in air
